dataPreservation.scope: Authenticated image-practice checks; anonymous editor/home checks cannot write learner state.

productionVerification.scope: Anonymous Chromium/WebKit at 390x844; user-authenticated Chromium for read-only image-practice checks. This is not the local synthetic-account regression suite.

observability.anonymous401: Each anonymous /api/state request returned 401 in the recorded passes. Authenticated baseline/after GETs for state and position returned 200. These observations do not attribute the historical 401 responses.
observability.dataComparison: Response hashes before/after image-practice verification only; not full database rows before/after deployment.

rollback.reason: No deployed application defect observed in requested checks.
rollback.rule: Retain card retirement; preserve learner and image position data. No reverse SQL, table deletion, old-backup overwrite or card setting restoration.

unresolved.startupExplanation: Current startup success does not establish the cause or absence of the historical one-off timeout.

verificationLimits: Real iPhone/VoiceOver and screen-reader user tests were not run.
WebKit checks used an anonymous desktop engine at 390x844; authenticated image flips used Chromium.
No learning writes, position moves, backup restore or real AI calls were tested in production.
Post-deploy initial-render success and anonymous /api/state 401 do not determine historical startup/401 causes.
Authenticated data hashes compare before/after smoke verification, not a database-wide before/after deploy audit.

priorRegression.full172ConditionMatrix: Historical run before the final four display-file paragraph fix; relevant tests were rerun after the fix. Not counted as a full final-source rerun.

toolingNotes: CUA kernel asset initialization failed twice; installed gstack Chromium fallback used, then user completed sign-in.
gstack skill-start helper was absent; existing browser remained usable; no setup or upgrade was run. Maintenance command: /gstack-upgrade.
Node22 fs.cpSync crashed; old dist was retained and Copy-Item copied the unchanged preverified build.

Official source helper pushed f5925ec; package failed under Node22, then GNU tar treated a Windows drive colon as remote. Existing Node24 and process-only TAR_OPTIONS=--force-local completed the same official helper. No persistent settings changed.

First read-only probe assertion counted a deliberately blocked Cloudflare platform POST as an application write. UI and asset checks passed; assertion corrected and both engines passed with all non-read requests still blocked.

evidence.privacy: Raw personal learning text, account/card identifiers, credentials and cookies are not copied into this release record.
